about: The deck visual checklist: one entry per check. kind yes_no answers yes, no or n/a; kind metric answers a value or n/a. n/a is never a pass. bench/checklist.py holds one function per id. Thresholds read from spec, theme or qa_render are named in the source, not copied. Each item has a tier: gate items count in compare --fail-on-regress; advisory items are reported but never fail it. A metric may carry direction higher, lower or same (any change is worse).

items.source: docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §7: with no policy severity entry, error is blocker and warn is minor (policy/repair.yaml does not exist until deck-repair-loop; when it does, its severity map is used)
items.na_when: validation.json is missing or is not a list; or qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'
